# Sijam Consults Limited (RC: 1715416)

> Sijam Consults Limited is an accredited Nigerian international educational consultancy, foreign labor documentation facilitator, and travel mobility advisory based in Kaduna, Nigeria.

## Core Operations & Verification
- **Company Name**: Sijam Consults Limited
- **Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC)**: RC: 1715416
- **Headquarters**: Suite 04, 2nd Floor, Gidan Badamasi, Kakuri Road, Kaduna State, Nigeria
- **Website**: https://sijamconsults.com
- **Official Contact**: info@sijamconsults.com | +234 803 289 8245

## Job Board & International Labor Corridors
Sijam Consults publishes verified foreign employer employment quotas and provides candidate file packaging for statutory work permits.
- **Job Board URL**: https://sijamconsults.com/jobs
- **Primary Employment Corridors**: Poland (Voivodeship Type A Permits), Slovakia (Single Work Permits), United Kingdom (Health & Care Worker CoS), Cyprus, Germany (Opportunity Card), Canada (LMIA), Czech Republic, and Global Sovereign Corridors.
- **Sectors**: Healthcare & Nursing, Logistics & Heavy Truck Driving (CE), Certified Structural Welding, Engineering & Construction, Multi-Skilled General Workers (Electrician, Plumbing, Construction, Agriculture), Hospitality & Tourism, Information Technology.
- **Statutory Notice**: Sijam Consults operates strictly as a documentation and immigration filing advisory. Visas are sovereign government decisions and cannot be purchased or guaranteed.
